name: Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS)
measures: Monthly labor force, employment, unemployment level and unemployment rate for ~8,300 areas including every US county, metro area, and state.
coverage: National — all US counties, metro areas, and states.
history_start: varies by area; many county series back to the early-to-mid 1990s
license: US federal statistical publication, public domain. The bulk flat files at download.bls.gov require no account; a free API key is only needed for BLS's API v2 (higher query volume), not for this bulk download path.
rate_limit: None on the bulk flat-file download used here.
proposed_use: A local labor-market-health signal (unemployment rate level and trend) feeding the Growth Score as a leading indicator alongside Census ACS income/demographic data, available for any US county.
recommendation_detail: Solid government source with full national county coverage and a long monthly history, but two practical frictions keep this at 'conditional' rather than 'approve': (1) the bulk files are fixed-width/pipe-delimited BLS 'time.series' format, not CSV, so the adapter needs a parser rather than a simple CSV reader (more adapter work than the other candidates here); (2) during the run, a source noted BLS canceled its October 2025 unemployment publication during a government shutdown, meaning the series can have unscheduled gaps that a consuming pipeline needs to tolerate. Worth building once a national labor-market pillar is prioritized, but it's more adapter effort than `fred-mortgage30us` or `census-building-permits-survey` for a less novel signal (Census ACS already carries some labor-force data).
